content: TASK-101 completed @archmap/lifecycle as an independently built Schema + Relations + Validation + Views workspace plugin with isolated/default installers and verified packed Node ESM consumption. Next, TASK-102 adds plugin-owned YAML section parsing and normalization while preserving v0.3 behavior and keeping Core free of lifecycle vocabulary. GitHub v0.3.0 is released; npm 0.3.0 remains deferred for later OTP completion.
